Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련 도중 실수한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>는 적당히 시키라며 짜증을 낸다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After messing up while training, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> blames me for pushing her too hard.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニング中にミスをした<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、苛立ちを見せている。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 在训练途中失误的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>不耐烦地说要适可而止。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 在訓練途中失誤的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>不耐煩地說要適可而止。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Pendant l'entraînement, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> fait une erreur et s'agace, en demandant de ne pas trop en faire.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Während des Trainings macht <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> einen Fehler und äußert genervt, dass man es doch bitte nicht übertreiben soll.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Durante el entrenamiento, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> comete un error y se molesta, exigiendo que no la fuercen tanto.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Durante o treino, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> comete um erro e se irrita, pedindo para que peguem mais leve.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ระหว่างฝึกซ้อม <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ทำผิดพลาดและบ่นอย่างหงุดหงิดว่า “พอได้แล้วน่า”
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Selama latihan, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> membuat kesalahan dan merasa kesal, meminta agar latihan dilakukan secukupnya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trong lúc huấn luyện, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mắc lỗi và bực bội yêu cầu làm vừa phải.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: प्रशिक्षण के दौरान गलती करने वाले <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को सही तरीके से करने के लिए कहते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Then shall we stop for today?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 今日はここまでにしよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Sollen wir es für heute gut sein lassen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¿Entonces, podemos dar por terminado el día?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: งั้นวันนี้พอแค่นี้ก่อนดีไหมคะ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Jadi, bagaimana kalau kita akhiri saja hari ini?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Vậy hôm nay chúng ta dừng lại ở đây nhé?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तो, क्या हम आज के लिए बस इतना ही करें?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 딱 한 번만 다시 해보면 어때?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: How about trying just one more time?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: もう一度だけやってみないか？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Et si on essayait juste une fois de plus ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wie wäre es, wenn wir es noch einmal versuchen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¿Qué tal si lo intentamos una vez más?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Que tal tentarmos só mais uma vez?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ลองอีกครั้งเดียวดีไหมคะ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Bagaimana kalau kita coba sekali lagi?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Thử lại một lần nữa thì sao?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: क्या हम इसे बस एक बार और कोशिश करें?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le da una poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบโพชั่นพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa một bình thuốc sinh lực.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: एक जीवन शक्ति औषधि देती है।

Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยักหน้าอย่างพึงพอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> gật đầu, có vẻ hài lòng.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 짜증은 풀리지 않는 것 같다...
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though I agreed to let her rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed irritated...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の苛立ちは収まらないようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还是没有消气…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還是沒有消氣…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Nous étions censés nous reposer, mais l'agacement de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ne semble pas s'estomper…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Wir sollten uns ausruhen, aber <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Ärger scheint nicht zu verfliegen …
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Se suponía que íbamos a descansar, pero el fastidio de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> no parece desaparecer…
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Era para descansarmos, mas a irritação de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> não parece diminuir...
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เราควรจะพักแล้ว แต่ความหงุดหงิดของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะไม่หายไป…
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Seharusnya kita istirahat, tapi kekesalan <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sepertinya tidak mereda…
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Chúng ta đáng lẽ phải nghỉ ngơi, nhưng vẻ khó chịu của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dường như không hề giảm bớt...
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हमें आराम करना था, लेकिन <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> की झुंझलाहट कम होती नहीं दिख रही है...

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> handled the rest of the training well.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、残りのトレーニングを見事にやり遂げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>完美地完成了接下来的训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>完美地完成了接下來的訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a mis fin à l'entraînement en cours de manière splendide.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beendete das laufende Training auf grandiose Weise.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dio un espléndido final al entrenamiento en curso.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> encerrou o treino em andamento de forma esplêndida.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> จบการฝึกซ้อมที่ดำเนินอยู่ได้อย่างยอดเยี่ยม
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengakhiri latihan yang sedang berlangsung dengan gemilang.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã kết thúc buổi huấn luyện đang diễn ra một cách tuyệt vời.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने चल रही ट्रेनिंग को शानदार तरीके से समाप्त किया।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> resumed her training, but failed again.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗してしまった。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a de nouveau tenté l'entraînement, mais a échoué.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> stellte sich dem Training erneut, scheiterte aber.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> volvió a intentar el entrenamiento, pero falló.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou o treino novamente, mas falhou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ท้าทายการฝึกซ้อมอีกครั้งแต่ล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lại thử thách buổi huấn luyện một lần nữa nhưng thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से ट्रेनिंग को चुनौती दी लेकिन असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s complexion visibly improved after drinking the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はポーションを飲んで顔色が明るくなった。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a bu la potion, et son teint s'est éclairci.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trank den Trank, und ihr Teint hellte sich auf.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bebió la poción y su tez se iluminó.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bebeu uma poção e sua tez clareou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดื่มโพชั่นและสีหน้าของเธอก็สดใสขึ้น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> meminum ramuan itu, dan wajahnya menjadi cerah.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> uống bình thuốc, và sắc mặt cô ấy trở nên tươi tắn hơn.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने औषधि पी ली, और उसका रंग निखर गया।
